product_one_liner.value: Matillion helps enterprise data teams build, transform, orchestrate and manage cloud data pipelines for analytics and AI, using low-code tooling and its Maia AI agents.

hq_location.notes: Dual headquarters: Manchester, United Kingdom, and Denver, United States.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts explain the pipeline reviewer’s frontend/backend, API and testing, and the architecture of Matillion’s internal multi-agent monitoring tool.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: Senior Staff AI Engineer on the Maia AI team.

model_provider.value: Amazon Bedrock (AWS); Anthropic; OpenAI; Azure OpenAI
model_provider.notes: Maia’s reasoning uses models accessed through Amazon Bedrock; Matillion also names Anthropic. OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are customer-configured AI Prompt integrations, not necessarily the providers behind Maia’s own reasoning.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 audit, ISO 27001:2022 certification and PCI DSS 4.0.1 certification are claimed. HIPAA and GDPR are stated compliance obligations, not separate certification awards.

last_funding.notes: Databricks Ventures investment announced November 8, 2022; amount undisclosed. The funding database classifies it as Series E. The earlier $150 million Series E in September 2021 is not the most recent investment.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest publicly listed funding is November 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the funding history was updated November 5, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Senior Sales Development Representative, Enterprise, Denver.

launched_6mo.notes: June 1, 2026: public preview launch of Mission Control and Context Engine, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tim O’Neil joined as CRO, announced March 11, 2026. Girish Pancha was appointed CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi Chief Development Officer on August 4, 2026; Matthew Scullion stepped down as CEO and remained a board member.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Internal stack signals from current and historical job postings; not merely product connector availability. Some systems appear as experience requirements, so this does not establish that every system remains deployed today.
